verdict.rationale: LightSprint offers a codebase analysis panel covering reliability and security, with recommendations you can turn into tasks. It also has a per-PR Merge Readiness score covering tests, linting, a11y and typecheck, and an onboarding agent that sets up the repo environment. None of these is described as a report on how ready the repository is for autonomous agents, so this only touches the story indirectly. Missing for 10: an explicit repo-level agent-readiness report or score, documentation of what such a report evaluates (e.g., test coverage, setup scripts, agent instructions), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
